# Perimity

> Perimity builds Pulse, the evidence layer for cyber insurance. Pulse reads security controls directly from a company's Microsoft 365, starting with MFA, so underwriters, brokers and MSPs can see what a "Yes" on a cyber insurance application actually means, before bind and during the policy. Access is read-only and approved by the company's own Microsoft 365 admin.

## Products
- [Pulse](https://perimity.io/pulse/mfa-analysis/): Pulse Evidence (a one-time, dated evidence pack read from Microsoft 365), Pulse Monitoring (a weekly re-check that flags changes, such as a new MFA exclusion), and the Pulse Evidence Request (free for underwriters: ask an applicant for an evidence pack; nothing is shared until the applicant approves).
- [Pulse Subjectivity Tracker](https://perimity.io/tracker/): every open carrier subjectivity in one list, for cyber brokers.

## Key points
- Pulse verifies controls; the answers on the application remain the applicant's. Pulse does not attest.
- Outside-in scans show the perimeter. Pulse shows the inside: verified controls, read from Microsoft 365.
